q1.question: Is KeyCare free to use?
q1.answer: Yes! KeyCare is completely free during the beta period. We may introduce premium features in the future, but core functionality will always remain free.

q2.question: Does KeyCare read my messages?
q2.answer: KeyCare analyzes text locally on your device to detect potential harm. We never store, transmit, or share your messages. Your privacy is our top priority.

q3.question: What languages are supported?
q3.answer: KeyCare currently supports English, French, and Arabic with full keyboard layouts and AI detection for each language.

q4.question: Does it work offline?
q4.answer: Yes! Core detection features work offline. For the most accurate AI suggestions, an internet connection is recommended but not required.

q5.question: How do I install the APK?
q5.answer: Download the APK, open it on your Android device, and follow the prompts. You may need to enable 'Install from unknown sources' in your device settings.

q6.question: Is there an iOS version?
q6.answer: Currently, KeyCare is only available for Android. An iOS version is on our roadmap for future development.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This notice describes the privacy behavior intended for the KeyCare hackathon MVP. It covers the public web demo and the shared processing principles used across product surfaces.

processing.title: What is processed
processing.content: KeyCare processes only the message text, selected action, and optional target language needed to fulfill the request. When you submit, the message is sent securely to the production KeyCare API over the network for the current request.

storage.title: Storage and accounts
storage.content: The MVP does not require an account, payment, or a persistent message database. Messages are not stored by default. Browser language preference may be kept locally on your device.

providers.title: AI providers and security
providers.content: The production backend may send request text to an AI provider to produce the result. Private provider credentials remain on the backend and are never included in client code, browser requests, or results.

rights.title: Your control
rights.content: KeyCare never sends a message on your behalf. The original and suggestion are shown separately. You can copy, edit, dismiss, or ignore every suggestion.

terms.title: MVP terms
terms.intro: These plain-language terms apply to the KeyCare hackathon MVP and public demo. The product is experimental and may change as the team tests and improves it.

purpose.title: Assistive purpose
purpose.content: KeyCare provides writing suggestions and tone signals. It does not make decisions for you, verify facts, provide professional advice, or act as an autonomous messaging service.

control.title: Your responsibility and control
control.content: Review every suggestion before using it. You remain responsible for your message, its meaning, its recipients, and the decision to send it.

availability.title: Beta availability
availability.content: The MVP is provided as available. Features, supported languages, integrations, and availability may change, and the service may be interrupted during development.

responsibility.title: Acceptable use
responsibility.content: Do not use KeyCare to violate the law, harm others, expose confidential information, or bypass the rules of another service. Avoid submitting sensitive information to an experimental demo.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: For questions about these terms, contact {{email}}.
